name: Bake-Danuki Wanderlust
description: A bake-danuki seems to be looking for help on Pudding Isle...

steps.description: Use Elemental Sight to look for clues
Change the stone formation on the right side of the bonsai to Leisurely Rocks
Look for Shibasuke on the mountain
Catch up with Mamesuke and Shibasuke
Catch up with Mamesuke and Shibasuke
Change the stone formation on both sides of the bonsai to Unyielding Rocks
Catch up with Mamesuke and Shibasuke
Catch up with Mamesuke and Shibasuke
Change the stone formation on both sides of the bonsai to Leisurely Rocks
Go to where the bonsai is once the island's anomalies have stabilized

dialogs.content: Eh? What's a bake-danuki doing on this island?
Mm... Shibasuke...
Eh? Did that bake-danuki speak?
Eek! Yellow Fur and... Flying White Fur?
Hey! You're just like Kichiboushi! Anyway, it's not Flying White Fur. The name's Paimon!
Paimora? Paimora knows Kichiboushi? Paimora, amazing!
Not Paimora, Paimon...! So, Kichiboushi is that famous now, huh? His training must be going well!
Bye... mon...?
Ugh, forget it... Wait! Why are we suddenly able to understand bake-danuki?
Ioroi once mentioned that bake-danuki can understand humans, but we can't understand them.
We could understand Kichiboushi before because we'd had a bake-danuki meal, but its effects didn't last that long...
These islands have always been really unusual.
Yeah... It's almost like nothing strange is strange here!
Mm... Shibasuke can't find...
Ugh... Paimon's getting confused. You mean you're Shibasuke, and you're searching for something?
Mmm... Dumb White Fur...
So you got separated from Shibasuke. Is that it?
Mm! Smart Yellow Fur! Mamesuke grateful!
Hmph, Paimon's got this one! It says its name is Mamesuke!
Ooh, bravo. Bye-mon bravo.
#{NICKNAME}! You too!?
Anyway, how did you get here, Mamesuke?
Playing with Shibasuke on unfamiliar boat.
Sleepy... Woke up! Lots of people!
Lots of wind on fists.
Big cold person.
That sounds mighty like the Fatui.
...The Fatty?
Leave ship and wait in cave. Fatty leave.
Shibasuke find way home, mountain kaboom!
Mountain kaboom? Oh! Is he referring to the mountains switching...
#What do we do, {NICKNAME}? Are we responsible for Shibasuke going missing?
Well, guess we'll have to take responsibility and help Mamesuke search.
Yeah, but how? ... Oh, Paimon knows what to do! Let's look for clues with your <color=#00E1FFFF>Elemental Sight</color>!
What do you mean "we"? All I hear are bake-danuki noises.
Huh? Has some strange ability awakened within Paimon? Is Paimon the Tanuki Whisperer now? ... Nah, that can't be it!

It's a leaf that contains the power of Anemo. Huh, speaking of those...
It's a leaf from the Mondstadt-styled mountain...
Yeah, but now a leaf covered in Anemo has found its way to an Inazuma-styled mountain, and Shibasuke is missing. That means...
Shibasuke might be on the Mondstadt-styled mountain.
Well, since we've found a clue, let's head back to Mamesuke!
We're back!
Shibasuke?
Well... We haven't found Shibasuke yet...
Mmmm...

Yeah, we just need another mountain kaboom.
Mountain kaboom!
Hmm... We can't leave you alone here, Mamesuke, so come with us!
Mm!
Mountain kaboom! ...Shibasuke?
Eh? Isn't that Mamesuke? What's Mamesuke doing here?
Eek! White Fur! Shoo!
Eh? Is that Shibasuke? It looks just like Mamesuke...
The bake-danuki of Inazuma are really difficult to tell apart...
Except Kichiboushi. He sure stands out from the crowd!
Kichiboushi? Lie!
We took Kichiboushi to train all across the lands! We were there when Ioroi told Kichiboushi to never stray from the tanuki path, you know? Hehe.
Ioroi? White Fur lie! Shoo!
Hmm... You're Shibasuke, right? Stop trying to get rid of us, Mamesuke sent us to find you.
...Mamesuke? Really?
Of course! Come with us. Mamesuke is waiting for you!
Hmph! White Fur lie?
Argh! He's so infuriating! He would be bake-danuki paste now if it wasn't for us!
They both look the same, so why is Shibasuke so stubborn...
Whew... that was difficult. We should have asked Mamesuke for proof.
Steal?
Gah, Shibasuke is so suspicious of everything.
A little vigilance never hurts when you're out of doors.
Eh? Come on, Paimon's super friendly-looking.
But the bake-danuki of Inazuma should be skilled at transforming. Shibasuke could've transformed into a butterfly or something and flown away just now, right?
Hmph! Dumb White Fur! Bake-danuki transformation not easy.
Eh? But bake-danuki who can transform into things like barrels and lamps can be seen all over Inazuma.
Mmm, not same.
How is it different?
Mm... White Fur talk too much! Won't understand...
Where Mamesuke...
Looks like Shibasuke isn't willing to talk anymore... Let's just take him back to Mamesuke!

Hearing that from Shibasuke feels so strange... But are they gonna be alright?
Some time later, you return to see Mamesuke and Shibasuke again...
Ooh! It's Mamesuke and Shibasuke!
You seem like you're having fun on this Mondstadt-styled mountain! The scenery here is quite different from Inazuma, right?
So much green! Wind so soft! Yey!
Furry grass so fun! *blows*
Yeah, if Inazuma is purple like lightning, then Mondstadt...
...Is green like the wind.
Eh-he.
But there are not-purple Lavender Melons, out of reach.
Eh? What are you talking about?
White Fur can fly. White Fur can get it?
Mamesuke lead way! Come!
Gah, these two are so impatient. Let's follow them!
Look! Not purple Lavender Melons! We want, but kapow!
#Oh, it's just a wind barrier! Hehe! We've seen many of these in our adventures across Mondstadt, haven't we, {NICKNAME}?
Speaking of wind barriers, why do they vanish once the thing inside them is taken, anyway?
Well, the thing they're protecting is gone, so...
...That sounds kinda sad.
White Fur can fly. White Fur get it?
Oh yeah... Wait! You know, you should learn to stop relying on others and solve problems by yourself.
Mmmm...
It seems a little too difficult for a beginner.
#Is that so? Hmph! Then experienced adventurers like {NICKNAME} and Paimon will have to teach you some lessons!
#There's Anemo Amber here, which is perfect. It'll create a wind current once destroyed. C'mon, {NICKNAME}, show them how it's done!
Ah! The current vanished so quickly... Well, not that there's no other way to do this...
White Fur no fear!
Wow! Shibasuke said that transformation isn't easy, so Paimon thought he wouldn't be good at it.
Shibasuke amazing! Transform into many things! But not when afraid!

Maybe it has something to do with soil and climate.

Hehe, Paimon knew it was a Flaming Flower.
Paimon remembers that Kichiboushi called it a fire flower. It seems bake-danuki have different names for it.
Flame grass~ fire flower~
Flame grass so hot.
There's a trick to picking Flaming Flowers! You have to extinguish them first to pick them safely.
You'll need water or ice on a sunny day, and it's even easier if there's a Hydro Amber nearby. If it's raining, just use Anemo to swirl the rain and wet it.
White Fur knows much, very amazing.

Anemo Amber, Hydro Amber, same?
Hmm... How should we explain this... They look almost the same, but one creates a wind current, and the other creates rain.
Mm!
Wow! Shibasuke transformed into a Hydro Amber!
I kinda wish you could transform too, Paimon...
Paimon can't do that!

Mm!

Hehe, Shibasuke's amazing too.
Mondstadt fun, but...
Not enough.

Maybe we can switch to the mountain style of Liyue.
Right! Mamesuke, Shibasuke! Would you like to see the scenery in Liyue?
Liyue fun?
There are Geovishaps there that inflict excruciating pain when they hit you.
Hey! Stop that! Who would want to go there after hearing that!?
Wow! Very fun!
We go!
Eh!?
Oh... Then let's do another mountain kaboom!
There are Jueyun Chilis there that make you spew flames.
Kaboooom~
Mountain kaboooom~
Yey! Wait moment!

Is it just like last time?

Fun! Very red, very yellow!

Eh? What's that?
Take White Fur see!
Whew... They're so fast...
Mmhaha! White Fur weak!
...Shibasuke is pushing its luck...
White Fur, look! Strange plate!
Oh, that! It's a mechanism activated by weight! Actually, there are some in Inazuma, too.
Weight?
Uh... Something heavy! Like...
Like Paimon.
Paimon isn't that heavy!
Mm... Lavender Melon?
Lavender Melons are too light!
Mmm... Hydro Amber?
Uh... Paimon's never tried it, but it probably won't work...
Mmm! Stones heavy enough!

Like a Meteorite.
Meteorites are really handy!
Yey! Box!
Woohoo! A chest!
Luckily, it didn't activate a challenge.
Even if it did, it would be really fun with Mamesuke and Shibasuke here to help!

White Fur no fear, Shibasuke strong.
Hehe, Mamesuke and Shibasuke are so reliable now!
Guess you've gotta work harder too, Paimon.
C'mon, Paimon has always been really reliable!

Strange sound there! Shibasuke check!
Mm! Mamesuke go too!
Eh? What strange sound? Paimon didn't hear anything... Ah!

So strong!

Eh!?

Woohoo! Mondstadt!
Mm! White Fur, Yellow Fur, so slow!
Alright! Let's go now!

Mm!
Mmmm!!!

Mm!

They can't speak anymore...

Later?
